macros.name: textva

macros.name: textvacal
macros.doc: The command \textvacal typesets its argument in the vacal font.

macros.name: va
macros.doc: The command \va changes the current font family to va and the encoding to T1.

macros.name: vacal
macros.doc: The command \vacal changes the current font family to vacal and the encoding to T1.
